page.overview:
Who is Garland?

Garland is a superboss in World of Final Fantasy Maxima. He is a Grymoirian incarnation of Garland originating from the first Final Fantasy, and is one of the three character representatives of that game, the other two being the Warrior of Light and Princess Sarah. He is located in the Hidden Dungeon along with incarnations of the Four Fiends.

Defeating Garland and the Four Fiends when playing World of Final Fantasy Maxima on the Xbox One unlocks the "Cycle of Battle" achievement.

Garland's appearance is inspired on his incarnation from Dissidia Final Fantasy, where he wears a suit of silver and gray armor with gold ornamentation, including gold settings containing blue orbs or gemstones on his waist, elbows, and the back of his hands. His cape is a shade between blue and purple with gold trim and a gold clasp and he wields a claymore.

Since Garland only appears in battles, his personality is not explicitly shown other than his brutalistic combat. However, according to his Mirage Manual entry, he can be surmised to still be arrogant as with his other appearances, as he self-proclaims with immense dark powers. His unmatched power makes him by far the most fearsome of the Grymoirians met so far, to the point where he is considered an Antichampion.
